integrity: Analytic real-domain proof with constructive equality examples; independent exact-rational enumeration and pointwise certificate checks supplied as an executable source file. Source priority is assessed by comparisons but not externally certified.
limitations: One facility, equal-weight agents, planar Chebyshev distance, social cost equal to the sum of distances; exact ratios depend on fixed population size and lower even-median tie breaking; no higher-dimensional, other-metric, or mechanism-optimality claim.
title: Finite-population parity law for coordinate-wise median facility location in the Chebyshev plane
